Range) |pvp_speed = 5 |pvp_hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |pvp_lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision & Splash only) |pvp_flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Tank''' is the fourth, and penultimate, vehicle that spawns from the [[Military Base]]. It spawns when the [[Military Base]] is at Level 4. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. The '''Tank''' has a spawnrate of 35 seconds, which is reduced down to 25 seconds in [[PVP]] mode. Like the [[Humvee 3]], the '''Tank''' has a gun that can deal damage to enemies as well as a splash-damaging cannon. These weapons can detect hidden enemies but cannot detect flying enemies, and the cannon can damage lead enemies. There is a limit of three units per [[Military Base]], limiting the amount of '''Tanks''' that can spawn. However, this should generally not be an issue, due to how hard it is to reach this limit. ==Appearance== The current version of the '''Tank''' is a heavily armored khaki tank, with a cannon protruding from its turret. Its caterpillar tracks are covered by armor. It has two antennas at the back. There is a mounted machine gun above the opening hatch of the '''Tank'''. The operator of the machine gun has tan skin, black shirt and mask, and green goggles. ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:ClassicTank2.png|175px]] |[[File:WastelandTank.png|175px]] |[[File:CyberTank.png|175px]] |[[File:Base1776Tank.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Premium|Classic}} |{{Color|Hexscape|Wasteland}} |{{Color|Deluxe|Cyber}} |{{Color|Patriotic|Base 1776}} |- !Obtained From |[[Premium Crate]] |[[Hexscape Event#Hexscape Event Battle Pass|Hexscape Event Premium Battle Pass]] |[[Deluxe Crate]] |''🦅 Eagle Screech'' [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]],
[[Patriotic Crate]] |- ! |[[File:IceCreamTank.png|175px]] |[[File:PirateTank.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Beach|Ice Cream}} |{{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} |- !Obtained From |[[Beach Crate]] |[[Pirate Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Tank''' is great for hordes of high health enemies, like the [[Slow Boss]], [[Speedy Boss]] and [[Molten Golem]]. **The '''Tank''' even fares quite well against other high health enemies that some towers struggle against, like the [[Molten Mech]] and [[Fallen Giant]]. **The '''Tank''' cannot be stunned, so it is quite useful against some major bosses. ***However, the '''Tank''' can be damaged by abilities that damage [[units]], like the [[Warden (Modern Enemy)|Warden]]. ****It can be completely destroyed by some other abilities (like the [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]]'s ''Void Stomp''). *On two-pathed maps, only one '''Tank''' will spawn per Level 4 [[Military Base]]. It will go down a random path. *The '''Tank''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Bulwark]] and [[Warden (Modern Enemy)|Warden]]. **Its cannon and explosion upon destruction can also deal full damage to enemies with defense. **While the '''Tank''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, the damage from its gun cannot. *The '''Tank's''' splash damage (through its cannon or upon its destruction) cannot damage enemies that are immune to splash damage, like the [[Wraith]]. **However, the '''Tank''' can still deal collision damage, as well as gun damage, against these enemies, as long as they are detectable or collidable. *The '''Tank's''' gun and cannon can detect hidden enemies, but cannot detect flying enemies. **These enemies may be indirectly hit by its explosions. **The '''Tank''' cannot collide with ghost enemies, like the [[Soul]]. *The '''Tank''' is not affected by any buff or debuff. ==Trivia== *Khaki versions of the second version of the '''Tank''' appears in [[Forest Camp]]. *The first version of the '''Tank''' appears as the [[Military Base]] Level 4 upgrade icon. ==Update History== {{Scroll|text= *'''10 July 2019''' -
